verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official MCP server, bundled in the desktop app, that connects Claude, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and Antigravity to the open editor. However, the docs frame it as a way to drive or edit Spline from the agent, not as a way to read design context for implementation. Code export (React/Next.js/Three.js) and a runtime Code API give agents some path into the design, but the MCP server works only in the desktop app and no public OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: documented read access to frames, variables, screenshots or component-to-code mappings via MCP/API; browser (non-desktop) MCP access; independent or hands-on corroboration.
